newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dresdner up on results, takeover talk.
newsitem.headline: Dresdner up on results, takeover talk.

text.p: Shares in Dresdner Bank AG surged on Tuesday after the second-ranked German commercial bank reported higher six-month results and said it was considering buying into an investment bank abroad.
Dresdner shares were up 3.85 marks, or 4.5 percent, at 86.70 marks after touching a session high of 87 marks.
The 30-share DAX index was up 0.4 percent.
Dresdner on Tuesday reported a 23 percent rise in first-half operating profit after risk provisions to 1.743 billion marks, slightly above the consensus forecast.
"The Dresdner numbers were very good. It seems that our forecasts and those of many analysts were set too low for all the banks," said analyst Stefan Ermisch at WestLB.
"Just like Deutsche, Dresdner has set itself a very clear strategy in investment banking that's really paying off.
He also said Dresdner was profiting from speculation about its corporate action plans.
"It seems to me increasingly likely that Dresdner will seek an increased co-operation with Allianz," he said of insurance group Allianz AG, which owns more than 20 percent of Dresdner.
